scope: aggregate owner-run engineering/research ledger; local synthetic tests are excluded from owner-run counts

active_compute_cost_estimate_usd.note: estimate from recorded run durations and observed SageMaker Studio rates; excludes idle Studio time, persistent storage, S3, taxes, credits, and unrelated projects

interpretation: A scientifically valid rejection counts as a successful run. Engineering/resource incidents that prevent the intended scientific decision are counted separately.
